entries.text: The bundled SQLGlot runtime moves from 30.24.0.17 to 30.25.0.1 (fork commit `87a34a6cc16f`), rebased onto upstream v30.25.0 with all carried patches retained. Across 653 shipped benchmark queries translated from the duckdb, postgres and netezza dialects into all 37 target dialects (72,483 translations), nine outputs differ, all for the DuckDB target: lambda arguments are now written `LAMBDA x : expr` instead of `x -> expr` (`LIST_TRANSFORM`/`LIST_FILTER` in the primitives benchmark and TPC-Havoc `1_v7`); every other translation is byte-identical and the DuckDB 1.5 floor accepts the new form. The retirement check ran against a live QuestDB; its outcomes are unchanged. The SQLGlot refresh waiver for v30.25.0 is removed.
